Reuse any equivalent current work. Follow the city's published solicitation route and inspect at most two original notices with plausible standalone data or documentation scope. For one fit, execute the smallest passing and failing fictional inputs against a quoted requirement and save the source hash, commands and actual outputs. Prepare a nonbinding CAD quote only where the original terms support the supplier and submission route. Quote the buyer's payment terms separately from Interac readiness. If public access ends at a login or the inspected notices omit a separable scope, record the exact observed limit and what original notice would reopen the route. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.
